Saumil Bandyopadhyay’s research in the PHI Lab is focused on developing photonic systems for artificial intelligence. He received his Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering from MIT, where his S.B and M.Eng. were also conferred. New year, new adventure. Starting this January, I will be joining the optical computing startup Opticore as their CTO. Around a year ago we founded Opticore, a startup to commercialize the technologies we conceived and proved back at MIT. I'm also happy that Kazuhiro (Kazu) Gomi and Yoshihisa Yamamoto have allowed me to remain involved part-time at NTT Research, so this will not be a good-bye to my NTT colleagues.
